battle.name: 大波蘭起義
battle.brief: 大波蘭起義於1918年12月在德國占領下的波茲南及大波蘭地區爆發，波蘭居民與國民軍反抗德國統治。起義方使用包括英國Enfield rifle（恩菲爾德步槍）在內的武器；此型號自1858年列裝，屬當時英軍步兵制式步槍。

kit.name: 恩菲爾德步槍
kit.history: 恩菲爾德步槍自1858年起作為英國陸軍制式步槍，配置於步兵班排，構成步兵分隊的主要火力，並長期擔任英軍步兵主力武器。

countries: 1918年12月27日至1919年1月5日，交戰主體是正在形成的波蘭國家機構與帝制崩解後的德國軍事體系。起義由波茲南向四方擴展，戰區包括前普魯士的波森省、卡利茲省、科寧省、斯武普斯克省及北波美拉尼亞，並沿通往比得哥什的鐵路軸線推進，所以它不是單一城區的騷亂。波蘭一方由大波蘭國民會議、其後成立的大波蘭議會與人民委員會協調，戰鬥主力是仍服德軍的波蘭籍士兵、戰俘獲釋者、地方武裝，以及編入軍令系統的鐵路和通信班；沒有由華沙直接派出的波蘭野戰軍參戰。德方則以波茲南駐軍、Landwehr後備營、警衛隊和陸續抵達的弗萊科爾斯作戰，糧秣、機槍和援軍同樣依靠鐵路與通往帝國本土的道路。
countriesEn: From 27 December 1918 to 5 January 1919, the belligerents were the Polish state institutions then taking shape and the German military system left behind by the collapse of the monarchy. The uprising spread outward from Poznań across the former Prussian provinces of Posen, Kalisz, Konin, and Słupsk, and into northern Pomerania, while advancing along the railway axis toward Bydgoszcz; it was therefore not a disturbance confined to one city. The Polish side was coordinated by the Greater Poland National Council, the Sejm of Greater Poland established shortly afterward, and the People's Committee. Its fighting strength consisted chiefly of Polish soldiers still serving in the German army, released prisoners of war, local armed formations, and railway and communications detachments placed under military command. No Polish field army dispatched directly from Warsaw took part. On the German side, the forces engaged included the Poznań garrison, Landwehr reserve formations, police units, and Freikorps arriving as the campaign developed. Their supplies, machine guns, and reinforcements also depended on railways and roads leading back to the German Reich.
people: 人物層面上，伊格納齊·達申斯基在12月26日代表團抵達波茲南後，於27日在市政廳號召奪取軍火，成為起義的直接政治發起者；他其後主持大波蘭議會並擔任人民委員會主席。米切斯瓦夫·涅德扎爾科夫斯基負責組織大波蘭國民會議及地方行政準備，使議會能迅速接管波茲南的軍事與行政機構。約瑟夫·道林被視為起義初期最重要的軍事組織者之一，參與建立大波蘭軍事指揮部；瓦迪斯瓦夫·安德斯在戰俘營獲釋後加入這套指揮系統，負責參謀、軍事聯絡及德語環境中的文件與口頭溝通。各支波蘭分隊多由原德軍的軍官、軍士和士兵帶領，因此紀律、裝備熟悉度及戰鬥經驗差異很大。德方高層的應急決定與魯登道夫的名字相連，波茲南及北方各駐地則分別由當地將領決定抵抗、撤退或投降；同一支德軍營內既有拒絕向波蘭戰士開火的波蘭籍士兵，也有據守陣地至最後的單位。
peopleEn: Among the principal figures, Ignacy Daszyński arrived in Poznań with the Polish delegation on 26 December and called from the city hall on the 27th for the seizure of arms, becoming the immediate political initiator of the uprising. He later presided over the Sejm of Greater Poland and chaired the People's Committee. Mieczysław Niedziałkowski organized the Greater Poland National Council and prepared the local administrative apparatus, enabling the Sejm to assume military and administrative control in Poznań rapidly. Józef Dowling was among the leading military organizers of the first phase and helped establish the Greater Poland military command. After being released from captivity, Władysław Anders joined that command and worked in staff planning, liaison, and the reading of German-language documents and communications. Polish detachments were usually led by officers, NCOs, and soldiers from the former German army, so discipline, familiarity with weapons, and combat experience varied considerably. On the German side, emergency decisions at the highest level were associated with Erich Ludendorff, while commanders in Poznań and the northern stations independently chose whether to resist, withdraw, or surrender. Some German units contained Polish soldiers who refused to fire on the insurgents, while others remained in their positions until the fighting ended.
kits: 波蘭戰士並沒有單一制式裝備。步槍主要取自德軍庫存，包括7.92×57毫米的Mauser Gewehr 98，其固定五發內倉使射手必須反覆裝填；較舊的Gewehr 88、Kar 98a，以及Mauser Model 1871/84仍在後備單位使用。部分前波蘭武裝與獲釋戰手則帶有法製Berthier Mle 1907/15步槍或Berthier Mle 1915卡賓槍。手槍主要是Luger P08等德制舊型。通用機槍以7.92毫米的Maxim MG 08/15和較重的MG 08為主，兩者均有固定供水與連續供彈的長槍身，適合占據車站、橋頭和建築物中的射擊位置。可投入砲戰的德製火炮包括7.7厘米FK 96野戰砲與10.5厘米leFH 16野戰榴彈砲，其砲彈與步槍的7.92毫米彈不可通用，必須分庫儲存、另行運送。前線分隊使用馬匹、馬車、火車和敞車載運人員、糧食及彈藥，並以軍用電話、鐵路電話和傳令保持聯絡。波茲南及其他軍械庫被奪取後解決了初期槍械來源，但各分隊所得型號與彈藥數量不均，前線也常因鐵路中斷而改用馬車和道路分隊。
kitsEn: The Polish fighters did not possess a single standardized loadout. Their rifles came chiefly from German stocks and included the 7.92×57 mm Mauser Gewehr 98, whose fixed five-round internal magazine required frequent reloading. The older Gewehr 88, Kar 98a, and Mauser Model 1871/84 were still held by reserve units. Some former Polish formations and liberated prisoners carried French Berthier Mle 1907/15 rifles or Berthier Mle 1915 carbines. Pistols were mainly older German types such as the Luger P08. General-purpose machine guns were principally the 7.92 mm Maxim MG 08/15 and the heavier MG 08, both long-barreled weapons with fixed water containers and belt feed, suited to positions in railway stations, bridgeheads, and buildings. German artillery available for fire support included the 7.7 cm FK 96 field gun and the 10.5 cm leFH 16 field howitzer. Their artillery ammunition was not interchangeable with the 7.92 mm rifle cartridge and had to be stored separately and transported in its own supply chain. Horses, carts, trains, and open wagons moved personnel, food, and ammunition, while field telephones, railway telephones, and messengers maintained contact. Seizure of the arsenals at Poznań and elsewhere solved the initial weapons shortage, but the types and quantities of ammunition reaching each detachment remained uneven, and the loss of railway service often forced units onto horse-drawn and road columns.
tactics: 起義前四十八小時的主要任務，是控制軍械庫、軍官營房、機車廠、電話總機、橋樑、車站及行政機關，使一處奪得的武器能迅速分配到其他分隊。波茲南的街區戰由小股突擊隊、機槍組和預先布置的射擊位置共同構成；進攻者利用短距火力支援交替移動，把守軍逐段逼離原有位置，並以奪得的通信器材統一命令。德軍防衛者占據建築物上層、車站和營房周邊的固定機槍位，並以野戰砲支援城郊；德軍在十二月二十八日前後發動的反擊未能重新奪回波茲南，庫萬武科一線的戰鬥也以德軍退向既有陣地告一段落。波蘭隊伍接著利用鐵路快速轉移，以夜間行軍、分散宿營和沿多條道路並行推進，避免全線作正面決戰。北路由羅果茲諾、亞尼科沃、旺格羅維奇一帶向皮瓦、納克沃及比得哥什延伸，另一支則經斯武普卡推向諾泰奇；接近車站、渡口和城郊後，部隊才集中兵力攻取鐵路設施與守軍陣地。十二月的積雪、結冰道路和較短白晝限制了騎兵與馬車速度，也使鐵路調度成為最可靠的移動方式。
tacticsEn: During the first forty-eight hours, the principal task was to seize arsenals, barracks, locomotive works, telephone exchanges, bridges, railway stations, and administrative buildings so that weapons captured in one place could be distributed rapidly to other detachments. Street fighting in Poznań was conducted by small assault groups, machine-gun teams, and prepared firing positions. The attackers used short-range supporting fire and alternating movement to drive German troops from one section at a time, while captured communications equipment allowed orders to be coordinated. German defenders occupied fixed machine-gun positions in upper stories, around stations, and near barracks, with field artillery supporting operations outside the city. A German counterattack around 28 December failed to retake Poznań, and fighting at Kowanówko ended with the Germans falling back to established positions. Polish columns then used railways for rapid displacement, night marches, dispersed billeting, and parallel movement along several roads rather than committing the entire force to one frontal battle. The northern axis ran through Rogoźno, Janikowo, and Wągrowiec toward Piła, Nakło, and Bydgoszcz, while another column advanced through Słupca toward Noteć. Concentrated attacks on stations, crossings, and the approaches to towns were made only after the columns closed. Snow, frozen roads, and short daylight in December reduced the speed of mounted and horse-drawn movement and made railway dispatch the most reliable means of shifting troops.
data: 12月26日，大波蘭代表團抵達波茲南；27日，市區各支波蘭分隊同時奪取軍械庫、軍官營房與重要交通設施，波茲南街區隨即交火。同日，大波蘭議會在首次會議中取得地方行政和軍事上的臨時主導權，並準備成立常設執行機構；德軍曾試圖以混合部隊收復波茲南，但在城內與城郊均未成功。29日至30日，戰線經庫萬武科向南北延伸，旺格羅維奇、羅果茲諾、穆羅瓦納戈斯利納等據點先後接通，北路則建立以波茲南、羅果茲諾、亞尼科沃、旺格羅維奇、克齊尼亞、皮瓦、納克沃至比得哥什為主的鐵路供應線，另一支經斯武普卡攻向諾泰奇。12月31日，大波蘭議會選出以達申斯基為主席的人民委員會，起義的軍事指揮與地方行政開始由同一套正式機構統籌。1919年1月3日，議會明確行使波蘭地方主權，斯武普卡方向部隊向北推進並在諾泰奇攻取車站與道路控制點；同月4日，北線越過納克沃，向比得哥什外圍和車站展開進攻。4日夜至5日，比得哥什的德軍依靠固定機槍陣地及預備隊逐街抵抗，波蘭部隊則結合鐵路到達的分隊與從道路接近的縱隊奪取車站、營區及軍械設施，德軍守軍最後向東退往西普魯士。5日，貝多維次克羅和伊諾夫羅茨瓦夫方向的攻擊成功，當地的主要戰鬥隨即收束，議會控制的區域由波茲南延伸至上述北方城市。現存德方與波方戰報多只記零星傷員、失聯與俘虜，陣亡和受傷總數無法可靠核對，因此本實錄不列出未經證實的精確傷亡數字。
dataEn: On 26 December, the Greater Poland delegation arrived in Poznań. On the 27th, Polish detachments in the city simultaneously seized arsenals, officer barracks, and essential transport installations, and street fighting began. The Sejm of Greater Poland convened its first session that day, assumed provisional direction of local administration and military affairs, and prepared a permanent executive body. German troops attempted to retake Poznań with composite formations but failed both in the streets and outside the city. On 29 and 30 December, the front extended northward and southward through the fighting at Kowanówko. Wągrowiec, Rogoźno, and Murowana Goślina were successively connected to the insurgent network, while the northern supply line took shape along Poznań, Rogoźno, Janikowo, Wągrowiec, Kcynia, Piła, Nakło, and Bydgoszcz; another column moved through Słupca toward Noteć. On 31 December, the Sejm elected the People's Committee, chaired by Daszyński, bringing insurgent military command and local administration under the same formal authority. On 3 January 1919, the Sejm explicitly exercised Polish sovereignty over the region. The column moving north from Słupca attacked the Noteć station and nearby road crossings, while on 4 January the northern force passed Nakło and opened its attack against the outskirts and railway station of Bydgoszcz. During the night of 4 January and the following day, the Bydgoszcz garrison resisted street by street from fixed machine-gun positions and prepared units. Polish troops arriving by railway and advancing along the roads captured the station, barracks, and military stores in combination, after which the German garrison withdrew east toward West Prussia. On 5 January, the moves toward Inowrocław and Żnin succeeded, the principal open fighting came to an end, and the area controlled by the Sejm extended from Poznań to those northern towns. Surviving German and Polish reports record only scattered casualties, missing men, and prisoners, and the total number killed or wounded cannot be checked reliably, so no unverified precise casualty figure is given here.
cause: 大波蘭起義有數十年的政治與軍事根源。這一地區在1772年和1793年的partition中先後被普魯士兼併，此後一百多年受到德國行政、軍法和教育體制支配；波蘭人仍建立射擊隊、地方政治組織及秘密軍事小組，維持獨立國家的主張與實力準備。第一次世界大戰又把大批波蘭青年編入德軍，使他們熟悉德式武器、訓練和後勤，也使戰後返鄉者與仍留營的波蘭籍士兵成為1918年的武裝核心。1918年11月德國革命後，中央權威削弱、地方駐軍自行解除或轉移武器，波蘭代表團又於12月26日抵達波茲南，政治領導人遂把奪取軍械與接管地方權力合併執行。因此12月27日的起義不是單純的偶發群眾事件，而是既有組織、返國軍人和德軍內部瓦解共同造成的武裝轉移。國際上逐漸被接受的民族與人民自決原則，以及正在召開的巴黎和會，為波蘭代表提出地方權力要求提供了外交背景，但起義本身並非由華沙或盟國軍隊策動。
causeEn: The Greater Poland uprising had political and military roots extending over several decades. The region was incorporated by Prussia in the partitions of 1772 and 1793 and thereafter remained for more than a century under German administration, military law, and educational institutions. Polish activists nevertheless established rifle organizations, local political bodies, and clandestine military groups that preserved the objective of an independent Polish state and prepared accordingly. The First World War placed large numbers of Polish youths in the German army, giving them familiarity with German weapons, drill, and logistics. Returning soldiers and Polish soldiers still in German ranks consequently formed the armed core of 1918. After the German Revolution in November 1918, central authority weakened and local garrisons began disbanding or transferring weapons. The arrival of the Polish delegation in Poznań on 26 December allowed the political leadership to combine the seizure of arms with the assumption of local authority. The outbreak on 27 December was therefore not a spontaneous disturbance but the result of existing organizations, returning servicemen, and the disintegration of the German military structure. Internationally, the principle of national and popular self-determination and the opening Paris Peace Conference gave Polish representations of local territorial claims a diplomatic setting, but neither Warsaw nor an allied army initiated the uprising.
impact: 起義最重要的直接成果，是使波茲南及周邊縣份脫離德軍當局的有效控制。大波蘭議會與人民委員會成立後，軍事命令、行政專員、鐵路調度、糧食徵集和軍械分配開始由同一套波蘭機構處理；被奪取的軍械庫供應了新編分隊，鐵路沿線也因兩側據點相繼落定而恢復部分運量。德軍則把殘存主力集中到西部與北部外圍，失去原先分散控制波森省各地的網絡。弗萊科爾斯及其他後備部隊開始向波蘭方向集結，顯示衝突可能演變成更長期的內戰，但德方高層當時仍優先維持西線與本國安全，沒有立即把全部可用兵力投入比得哥什方向。比得哥什在1月5日易手，使波蘭代表在巴黎和會能以實際控制線而不只是領土主張作為論據，也削弱了德方繼續聲稱擁有前波森省大部分地區的依據。作戰中形成的地方分隊、軍官和軍士日後成為大波蘭陸軍的骨架，若干游擊式編制被整編為營、團及師級單位；但這些重組也顯示，起義成功主要依靠奪取武器、切斷德軍控制及多路並行，而不是建立一套可立即承受長期消耗的統一野戰軍。
impactEn: The most direct result of the uprising was the removal of effective German military control from Poznań and the surrounding counties. After the Sejm of Greater Poland and the People's Committee were established, military orders, administrative commissions, railway dispatch, food collection, and weapons distribution came under the same Polish institutions. The seized arsenals supplied newly formed detachments, while the railway service recovered in part as points on both sides of the line came under insurgent control. The Germans concentrated their remaining forces in the western and northern peripheries and lost the network that had previously controlled dispersed parts of Posen. The assembly of Freikorps and other reserve formations showed that the conflict could become a prolonged civil war, but the German high command still prioritized the western front and the security of the Reich and did not immediately commit every available unit toward Bydgoszcz. The capture of Bydgoszcz on 5 January enabled Polish representatives at the Paris Peace Conference to argue from an actual line of control rather than from territorial claims alone, weakening the German basis for continued possession of most of the former Province of Posen. The local detachments, officers, and NCOs created during the fighting later provided the framework of the Greater Poland Army, with several insurgent formations reorganized into battalions, regiments, and division-sized units. These reorganizations also revealed that insurgent success had depended chiefly on seized weapons, the disruption of German control, and parallel movement along several axes rather than on an integrated field army capable of sustaining a long war of attrition.
result: 至1919年1月5日，波蘭起義軍與大波蘭議會已控制波茲南、卡利茲和科寧一帶的主要城市，並把控制線向北延伸至比得哥什、伊諾夫羅茨瓦夫、貝林和北波美拉尼亞的部分據點；德軍仍保有大波蘭西部若干縣份及南部邊界附近的地區，因此軍事結果不是無條件的全面兼併。大規模公開戰鬥在比得哥什陷落後大致停止，起義單位的指揮權則轉入人民委員會與大波蘭軍事指揮部，鐵路和行政機構開始以常設形式運作。真正的邊界結果由凡爾賽條約及其後的邊界委員會確定：條約把前波森省及西普魯士省南部的大部分地區割讓波蘭，使波蘭取得通往波羅的海的波美拉尼亞走廊，同時切斷德國本土與東普魯士之間原有的多數陸路聯繫；德國仍保有一條通往東普魯士的走廊及西部邊境地帶。上西里西亞等西部問題並未由這次起義解決，留待1921年的公民投票處理。綜合而言，起義以具體的武裝行動迫使德軍放棄前波森省內地，創建可運作的波蘭地方權力，並把軍事占領線轉化為凡爾賽談判中的重要既成事實；其主要成果由波蘭軍事控制、地方行政建立及後來的條約承認共同構成，而不是以任何單一戰役的傷亡數字判定。
resultEn: By 5 January 1919, the Polish insurgents and the Sejm of Greater Poland controlled the principal cities around Poznań, Kalisz, and Konin, and had extended their line northward to Bydgoszcz, Inowrocław, Żnin, and several positions in northern Pomerania. German troops still held parts of western Greater Poland and areas near its southern frontier, so the military outcome was not an unconditional annexation. Large-scale open fighting largely ended after the fall of Bydgoszcz, while command of the insurgent formations passed to the People's Committee and the Greater Poland military command. Railways and administrative institutions began operating on a permanent basis. The final boundary outcome was determined by the Treaty of Versailles and subsequent border commissions. The treaty assigned most of the former Province of Posen and southern West Prussia to Poland, gave Poland the Pomeranian route to the Baltic Sea, and severed most of the former land connection between the German Reich and East Prussia, while Germany retained a corridor to East Prussia and territories along the western frontier. Questions in areas such as Upper Silesia were not settled by the uprising and were later submitted to the 1921 plebiscite. In aggregate, the uprising compelled the German army to relinquish the interior of the former Province of Posen, created functioning Polish regional government, and converted a military line of control into an important established fact in the Versailles negotiations. Its principal results consisted of Polish military control, the establishment of local administration, and subsequent treaty recognition, rather than any verdict based on a single numerical casualty count.
